description: With cas.first_data_timeout_ms set, the Called node uses it as given, and the unset soft link minimum hold stays three answer waits whatever the ladder.
note: Flow as cas-make-called-first-data-timeout up to the link being made, with cas.first_data_timeout_ms 600000 and a drc.table, and the run ends once the link's timers have started. At 2000, from 0.0.1.3 (EOT 10), a type 8 D_PDU carrying a PHYSICAL LINK REQUEST with the Ed4 bit set, which records 0.0.1.3 Ed4 (B-0408); the CAS answers PHYSICAL LINK ACCEPTED, sent at 52000 after the contention wait of 45000 (seed 0, slot 15), at drc.default_speed WN 2 Long since 0.0.1.3 has sent no recommendation. The table's thresholds list is empty, so the burst at 1000 to 3000 gives no estimate and 0.0.1.3, heard and recorded Ed4, is owed MAX-SEGMENT alone, 0xAFF (value 255 to a sender that has sent no SENDER-APPROACH; interp C-1271, C-1272), and no top priority. With a calibrated table this node sends its SENDER-APPROACH, 0xB04, first in a transmission that carries data to the peer, here the type 8 D_PDU (interp C-1286), so the accept carries 0xB04 in place of the template's CAPABILITY 0xF01; that D_PDU differs only in its EOW and header CRC. The link is made at 57550 (B-0213, B-0400) and cas.first_data/0.0.1.3 starts (B-0215, B-0216), then the SIS soft link timers, unset and so derived (A-0321). The derived first-data wait (interp B-0420, revised corpus 0.33.0; corpus-format.md section 6): n answer waits, n = max(3, ceil(2054 / c) + 2), where 2054 bytes is the largest DATA C_PDU (1-octet C_PCI, B-0111; 5-octet S_PCI with a TTD, A-0160; a 2048-byte U_PDU at the MTU, A-0047) and c the user bytes one transmission of the configured length carries on the ladder's slowest rung, ladder[0], after D_PDU overheads: b = floor((min(127500, dts.max_transmission_ms) - preamble_ms - flush_ms) / block_ms) blocks, at least 1, hold k = b x block_bytes - modem.eom_bytes bytes (C-0551, C-1042, C-1290), cut into DATA-ONLY D_PDUs of at most dts.max_segment_size bytes, each with o = 23 bytes of overhead (2 sync, C-0082; a 10-byte header with its CRC, C-0111, C-0175; the largest address field, 7, C-0074; the 4-byte CRC-32, C-0157), so with s = dts.max_segment_size, q = floor(k / (s + o)) and r = k - q x (s + o), c = q x s + max(0, r - o). The 2 added waits are a retransmission and the turn, the floor's own reasoning. c below 1 gives n = 3. The answer wait is the derived dts.ack_wait (C-1120): min(127500, dts.max_transmission_ms) + max(lbt_wait_dcd_ms, lbt_wait_vdcd_ms) + num_cont_slots x cont_slot_width_ms. Here the configuration is that of cas-first-data-wait-from-slowest-rung (dts.max_transmission_ms 30000, ladder WN 1 Long then WN 2 Long, WN 1 Long 50 bytes and 9600 ms a block, answer wait 108000), where the unset wait is derived as 19 answer waits, but cas.first_data_timeout_ms is set to 600000, so cas.first_data/0.0.1.3 starts with 600000 (B-0215, B-0216). The minimum hold follows the first-data wait only when that is derived (interp A-0321, revised corpus 0.34.0), so sis.soft_link_min_hold_ms unset gives three answer waits, 324000; idle 324000 and maximum 648000 as before.
